test_name: Camera toolbox slow-down-time and pause do nothing - 923799b3-cb28-414b-ba3c-04eea24ebebf
summary: Whenever the player was in a singleplayer mech, the Camera Toolbox hit an error every frame before it could apply the time scale, so pause and slow motion did nothing, with or without a recording. The error came from the toolbox trying to show a quick-capture recording marker that only exists on the multiplayer mech OS. A July change removed the check that skipped the missing marker. I put the check back. In the Petting Zoo sandbox challenge with enemies, I then checked from code: the toolbox's Pause set the game time scale to 0 and a running Junkdog froze in place, the slow-motion knob at x0.5 gave a time scale of 0.5, and Pause also worked during a recording. The toolbox's own errors are gone from the console. In built-in sandbox scenarios such as challenges, the slow-motion knob is still greyed out on purpose; only debug builds, the gym and user-made scenarios allow it.
instructions:
TASK: camera toolbox 'slow down time' and 'pause' do not work

DESCRIPTION:
tested in the sandbox where it should work with enemies and also in rec time, both do not work

REQUEST (from Amit):
investigate and fix
verified: Toolbox Pause in the Petting Zoo sandbox challenge sets Time.timeScale to 0 and a moving Rabid Junkdog stays frozen for 3+ s of real time
Toolbox time-scale knob at x0.5 sets Time.timeScale to 0.5
Toolbox Pause while a recording is running sets Time.timeScale to 0
No MechOS/CinematicViewer UnassignedReferenceException in the console after the fix
not_done: VR controller input (hand-turned knob, button presses) not exercised - no headset; the same methods were called from code
The knob stays disabled by design in built-in sandbox scenarios (IsTimeScaleDisabled); not changed, needs a design decision if it should be allowed
IsTimeScaleDisabled throws when the sandbox has no active scenario (seen only after a machine-local scenario load failure); not changed
console_errors: Kinematic - Rigidbodies should never EVER EVER be scaled - even kinematic ones! (pre-existing, sandbox arena props)
LCK Game audio data copy failed (recording without audio device on the cloud machine)
Debug action 'Combat/Spawn/Junkdog' not found (wrong action name in a test call)
